cling.note: natural half-face + hand behind the wall; wall edge detected at x=25-27, crop x0=31; no hard mask

source.background: flat green screen RGB≈(131,161,114) exit / (144,165,115) idle; moving watermark removed by largest connected component

keying.method: same green chroma key as r3 + largest connected component + plate-colored gaps + 2px edge projection + silhouette ring despill
keying.alphaSource: computed; r4 keeps the exact r3 alpha/geometry
keying.wallEdge: per-frame detected 25-27 px; action crop x0=31 (guard band), no wall pixels in atlas
keying.watermark: not connected to the character; removed by component filter
keying.whiteProtection: white dress/gloves/shoes and face/skin are opaque core; only outer rim RGB is pulled toward nearest interior color

fringeCleanup.note: r4: contaminated opaque ring/edge RGB mixes 80%/65% toward nearest interior core color; alpha untouched; light cream rim/yellow tint reduced

return.note: return = exit 逐帧反向；不 spin。贴边裁切线已在素材里，舞台不再额外平移。

cell.note: not an integer grid; use rects/frameMap

notes: r4 2026-11-12: same frames/anchors as r3; only contaminated outer rim RGB moved toward interior color (alpha/geometry byte-identical).
exit 5.0-7.0s sped 2x to 1.0s; return is exact reverse; no spin action.
